content.text: My journey into the world of wellness started back in 2019 after trying just about every diet in the world. I found most diets bring results but none of them seemed to be sustainable longterm. Now, as a certified nutritionist, I've taken a more wholistic approach to health and dedicated myself to translating nutrition so that is can be implemented by anyone.
